limitations.costs: Every POI cost is null: the source contains no prices. Budget levels are authored constraints and no budget effect or global budget feasibility is identifiable.
limitations.hours: Opening windows project documented source daily strings (or 24/7) onto authored counterfactual dates in +07:00; this is not fresh verification that a venue is open on those dates. Absent/unsupported source hours stay empty (unknown), never 'always open'.
limitations.freshness: Collection time, freshness, licence, source URL and rating are absent in the supplied snapshot and are not invented.
limitations.sampling: Purposive eight-POI supported-hours pool plus one exact missing-hours singleton; not representative of all 6367 prepared records or current venues. P20's empty selected pool is an authored stress test, not evidence that the source has no POIs.
limitations.design: Five profiles x four variants with ten cases at each marginal level of day count, mode, visit length and budget; not a full factorial and not an isolated-factor causal design. Factors are confounded.
limitations.multi_day: Production multi-day semantics carry the last scheduled POI as the next-day origin and charge directed inbound travel after the new day start; an empty day preserves the origin. The candidate input supplies only the actual directed pair matrix for the selected IDs; every cross-day leg is looked up from that same actual matrix, never invented. No accommodation, hotel or traffic model is assumed.
limitations.status: Unfrozen candidate input. It is not an accepted study, contains no model outputs or expected outcomes, and supports no H2/H3 finding.
